fit.sheet: Nisshinbo Micro Devices NJM4580 data sheet (Ver. 20260723), at ±15 V; phase margin assumed (D-169)
fit.figure: Electrical characteristics at ±15 V: AV 110 dB typ, GB 15 MHz at 10 kHz, slew rate 5 V/µs, supply current 6 mA, VOM ±13.5 V typ at RL ≥ 2 kΩ; Maximum Output Voltage vs. Load Resistance graph, about ±14 V at 10 kΩ. No phase margin
fit.method: A small macromodel (scripts/fit_models.py opamp_card, D-162): a tanh transconductance stage limited to 10 µA into C1 sets the slew rate, gm the unity-gain crossing and R1 the open-loop gain; a second pole gives the phase margin; diode clamps and an output resistance set the swing; the supply current is drawn from the rails. The gain at 10 kHz held to the sheet's GB (the crossing set to 15 MHz × cos 30°); phase margin 60° assumed, as the user chose (D-169): the sheet's only phase data, a 40 dB closed-loop graph, fits a slower part (9.3 MHz, about 31°) that disagrees with its own table. Output resistance 93 Ω and clamps 0.87 V from each rail fitted to the 2 kΩ row and the 10 kΩ graph point.
fit.note: Input bias, offset, noise, common-mode limits and the output's current limit are not modelled: the input stage is ideal (1 TΩ).
